_doc: Renders that may fail the comparison for an explained reason: { build: { design: reason } }. compare reports them as KNOWN instead of FAIL. Every entry needs a reason. An entry may instead be { "reason", "maxMae", "maxOver24" }: KNOWN only within those limits (mean error, % of card pixels off by more than 24), FAIL past them.

webgpu.holo-styles: Holo sparkle / cosmos cells come from fract(sin(x) · 43758.5453), whose result depends on the GPU's sin precision (holo-shader.ts: 'cell placement is driver-dependent; only the statistics are meant to match'). Chrome's WebGPU evaluates sin differently from WebGL, so the cells land elsewhere.
webgpu.preset-cosmos-sparkle: As holo-styles: driver-dependent sparkle / star cell placement.
webgpu.preset-shiny-lime-tile: As holo-styles: driver-dependent sparkle cell placement.

addon-shine-vines.reason: Shine's glow brightens the chip and text silhouettes, which already differ by a pixel between the engines, and here the vines' too: at the edge pose, natively at contain fit, it sits at the 0.75 bar (WebGPU 0.68). Limits catch a real regression.
